does: Leaves sauced wide rice noodles still against a very hot wok so that they catch dark, smoky spots before they are turned.
how: Heat the wok until it smokes.
Add the noodles with their dark sauce and toss once to coat.
Spread them out and leave them still until the underside catches dark spots.
Turn them and repeat, tossing gently so that they do not tear.

cues.text: Dark brown, almost black spots on glossy noodles.

mistakes.mistake: Tossing all the time, so the noodles never char.
Crowding the wok, which cools it so the noodles steam.
mistakes.fix: Cook no more than a few portions at once.

variant_of.differs: The noodles are left still against the hot wok between turns, so that they char rather than only heat through.
